nodes.name: Error Webhook
nodes.notes: n8n Error Trigger - configure as error workflow in n8n settings

parameters.query: INSERT INTO workflow_execution_stats (client_id, workflow_name, execution_id, status, started_at, error_message, retry_count) VALUES ({{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.workflow_name }}', '{{ $json.execution_id }}', 'error', '{{ $json.timestamp }}', '{{ ($json.error_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 0); SELECT log_audit({{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.workflow_name }}', 'error_occurred', 'workflow', NULL, '{{ JSON.stringify({node: $json.error_node, type: $json.error_type, severity: $json.severity, retryable: $json.is_retryable}) }}'::jsonb, 'error', '{{ ($json.error_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
UPDATE workflow_execution_stats SET retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE execution_id = '{{ $json.execution_id }}'
